bays.tariff: Up to 1 hour £4.80 (£7.20 diesel); up to 4 hours (Mon to Fri) £10.00 (£15.00); all day (Mon to Fri) £13.70 (£20.60); up to 4 hours (Sat & Sun) £6.30 (£9.50); all day (Sat & Sun) £10.00 (£15.00) (Tower Hamlets parking charges 2026/27)
bays.pay: Pay via an approved parking app (National Parking Platform) or machine at the car park

bays.restriction: Residential Parking Zone Canning Town — permit holders only during the restricted hours; visitors can pay in shared-use bays
bays.tariff: Paid bays in this zone charge by emissions tier (per hour): Tier 1 (0–50 g/km) £2.00; Tier 2 (51–110) £2.90; Tier 3 (111–170) £3.80; Tier 4 (171–225) £4.70; Tier 5 (226+) £5.60; diesel surcharge £1.00 per hour. At 30-minute maximum-stay locations the same tiers charge per 30 minutes: £1.00 / £1.45 / £1.90 / £2.35 / £2.80, diesel +50p. Resident permits by emissions tier (12 months / 1 month): Tier 1 £33.00 / £3.30; Tier 2 £66.00 / £6.60; Tier 3 £110.00 / £11.00; Tier 4 £165.00 / £16.50; Tier 5 £220.00 / £22.00 (Newham Council resident permit costs)
bays.pay: PayByPhone (phone 020 7005 0055) in shared-use bays; permits via MiPermit
